name: @zena-lang/google-cloud
description: Google Cloud clients for Zena: credentials, Firestore and Cloud Storage

test.#command: Runs from the repository root, which is what the paths inside the tests are relative to and where the compiler finds the package map.

test:emulator.#command: The client against the Firestore emulator over gRPC. Not part of `test`: the emulator needs the flake's `emulators` shell (firebase-tools and Java, about 2 GB), which the root `emulators:start` service enters itself.

generate.#command: Regenerates the Firestore and Cloud Storage API modules from the vendored protos. The test fails when either is out of date.
generate.command: cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena-cli run --dir . packages/protobuf/bin/generate.zena -- -I packages/protobuf/protos -o packages/google-cloud/zena/firestore-v1.zena google/firestore/v1/firestore.proto && ./target/release/zena-cli run --dir . packages/protobuf/bin/generate.zena -- -I packages/protobuf/protos -o packages/google-cloud/zena/storage-v2.zena google/storage/v2/storage.proto
